QuestInfo.name: Moonie's Depression
QuestInfo.0: The kidnapped Elf child, Moonie, is back in town. As the ruler of the Elves, you should check on him and make sure he's okay.
QuestInfo.1: Moonie is a sad Elf. His friends and teachers are frozen in ice, and he's all alone. Lift his spirits with a happy tune!
QuestInfo.2: Moonie felt a lot better after you played him some music. Now, if only the other children weren't frozen in ice...

0.0: H-hello, Your M-majesty. Th-thank you for rescuing me. \r\n#L0##bWhat's wrong, little one? Are you feeling okay?#l\n#k
0.1: I-I'm sad. Deet, Roa, and Teacher are all stuck in the ice. And the Elders're all too busy to hang out with me... \r\n#L0##bOf course! I'm sorry you're so alone. Would you like to play a game with me?#l\n#k
0.2: N-no, Your Majesty! You're too busy! I'm fine, so I want you to keep doing what you're doing. How else're my friends gonna get out of the ice?

yes.0: (Moonie is quite brave for his age! Of course your training is important, but isn't there anything you can do? Perhaps turn some cheery music to lift his spirits?

1.0: Did you change the music, Your Highness? It's...nice. I feel a lot better! Thanks!

yes.0: Maybe my friends are still frozen, but you'll get 'em out. I know you will!
